value:
SAY: Weekly gatherings are more than I'm used to, so I can do up to two weekend gatherings a month, under 10 people, with Thursday notice and a quiet-down by 11:30pm.

CNF:[gwk:gap(your weekly vs my once a month or less; I wake 6am-8am and want quiet late)]
FLX:[gwk:Up to 2 weekend gatherings a month, under 10 people, notice by Thursday, common areas quiet by 11:30pm|if other weekends stay low-key and after-hours socializing moves to your room or out]
FLX:[cln:Rotating chore chart with weekly check-in works; I'll draft the "tidy" checklist for kitchen and bathroom|if you edit it with me before move-in]
